name: SetupWizard
short: A guided setup for new servers.
description: `[p]setup` walks a server's admins through setting ButlerBot up: permissions, staff roles, the welcome flow, game nights, AI chat, voice rooms, auto-replies, stats, moderation, weekly games and slash commands. Each step shows what's set and changes it with Discord's own pickers, by running the server's own commands privately.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores which setup steps each server has looked at. It stores no data about users.
author: Quillshot
